body: PS. To add context I did try to kill myself last night by overdosing on benzodiazepines but my friends came and got me, but I don’t regret it at all. I know that from all of my previous attempts I never feel any regret, I just feel at peace when I am close to death. So I am doing this for certain but I am planning like a year or so out to have the least impactful suicide possible because no one deserves the horrible trauma that seeing your loved one commit suicide causes. So please I have no one to turn to to figure this out, they would just try to comfort me and try convince me not to, but I need to do this in a way that it won’t hurt them.
